observations: Photo 0: a small pile of used car parts leaning against an outside wall under a window.
Two CV drive shafts with rubber boots still fitted, one with a rusty inner joint.
One rack and pinion steering rack with a power steering valve body, rubber boot and pipes attached.
One thin aluminium fin core on the right, which looks like an AC condenser rather than a thick radiator.
One starter motor on the ground, with a grooved pulley beside it and a small rusty bracket or caliper carrier at the bottom.
Parts are dusty, greasy and rusty, with rubber boots and plastic still attached; they are mixed, not sorted by metal.
By size this whole lot is a few tens of kilograms, roughly 40 to 60 kg at most: two drive shafts, a steering rack, a condenser and a starter. Nothing near 500 kg is in the photo.
No scale, weighbridge ticket or scale display is shown.

identity.kind: mixed scrap car parts lot: two CV drive shafts, power steering rack, AC condenser, starter motor

claims.claim: Two drive shafts, a steering rack, a radiator or condenser and a starter motor
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two CV drive shafts, a steering rack, a thin AC condenser and a starter motor, plus a pulley and a small bracket.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a handful of car parts that together weigh a few tens of kilograms, roughly a tenth of the claim; no scale display or ticket is shown.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows greasy, rusty parts with rubber boots, hoses and plastic still attached, and steel, aluminium and copper bearing parts mixed together.
Cannot be checked from a photo; these are solid parts, so water would matter little to the weight.

claims.claim: Sold as is, for parts, repair or recycling
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows used, removed parts in scrap condition.

risks.risk: Real weight is far below the claimed 500 kg
risks.proof: Photo or clip of the whole lot on a scale with the display readable, with a handwritten dated note in shot
risks.if_unproven: priced at the weight estimated from the photo, a few tens of kilograms, not the claimed weight

risks.risk: Mixed metals and attached rubber, plastic and oil lower the yield per kg
risks.proof: Photo of the parts separated into steel, aluminium condenser and starter motor piles
risks.if_unproven: priced as mixed dirty steel scrap with attachments

risks.risk: Starter motor may be hollow or stripped of its copper windings
risks.proof: Photo of the starter motor end cap removed showing the windings
risks.if_unproven: priced as plain steel, no copper value

risks.risk: The lot shown may be only part of what is claimed or not all the seller's own
risks.proof: Clip walking around the full lot in one take with a handwritten dated code in shot
risks.if_unproven: priced as only the parts in photo 0

proof_requests: Clip of the whole lot on a scale with the display readable and a handwritten dated code in shot
Photo of the parts sorted by metal type
Photo of the starter motor opened to show the copper windings
response.reason: The lot is plainly two drive shafts, a steering rack, a condenser and a starter motor, so it can be priced as mixed car part scrap at the weight seen; the 500 kg claim is contradicted by the photo and must not raise the price.
